newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-STICH DEFINITELY OUT OF FRENCH OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-STICH DEFINITELY OUT OF FRENCH OPEN.

text.p: Germany's Michael Stich confirmed on Saturday that he would definitely not play in the French Open next week.
Stich, a finalist at the Paris grand slam last year when he lost to Yevgeny Kafelnikov, had already said on Thursday that he would not play at Roland Garros because of a nagging shoulder injury.
But on Friday the 1991 Wimbledon champion said he was reconsidering his decision after talking to tournament officials.

"I had talked to the referee in Paris and he asked me to reconsider and give it one more try," said Stich, following his 2-6 7-6 6-4 win over Swede Magnus Gustafsson at the World Team Cup on Saturday.
"I played decent today but my shoulder still hurts and my serve is not there. This was three sets and in Paris you have to serve well for four or five sets and I'm not capable of that."
